title: v1_110
content:
# February 2026 (version 1.110) _Release date: March 4, 2026_ --- **Security update**: The following extension has security updates: [GitHub.copilot-chat](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=GitHub.copilot-chat). **Update 1.110.1**: The update addresses these [security issues in core](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A%22February+2026+Recovery+1%22+) and these security issues in the [GitHub Copilot Chat extension](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20is%3Aclosed%20milestone%3A%22February%202026%20Chat%20Recovery%202%22). Welcome to the February 2026 release of Visual Studio Code. **This release makes agents practical for longer-running and more complex tasks**, giving you more control and visibility, new ways to extend agents, and smarter session management. * [Agent plugins](#agent-plugins-experimental): install prepackaged bundles of skills, tools, and hooks from the Extensions view * [Agentic browser tools](#agentic-browser-tools-experimental): let the agent drive the browser to interact with your app and verify its own changes * [Session memory](#session-memory-for-plans): persist plans and guidance across conversation turns * [Context compaction](#context-compaction): manually compact conversation history to free up context space * [Fork a chat session](#fork-a-chat-session): create a new, independent session that inherits conversation history to explore alternative approaches * [Agent Debug panel](#agent-debug-panel-preview): get real-time visibility into agent events, tool calls, and loaded customizations * [Chat accessibility](#accessibility): use chat to its fullest with screen reader improvements, keyboard navigation, and notification signals * [Create agent customizations from chat](#create-agent-customizations-from-chat): generate prompts, skills, agents, and hooks directly from a conversation * [Kitty graphics protocol](#terminal): render high-fidelity images directly in the integrated terminal Happy Coding! ---
>If you'd like to read these release notes online, go to [Updates](https://code.visualstudio.com/updates) on [code.visualstudio.com](https://code.visualstudio.com).
> **Insiders: Want to try new features as soon as possible?**
> You can download the nightly Insiders build and try the latest updates as soon as they are available.
> [Download Insiders](https://code.visualstudio.com/insiders)
